home.description1: Computer Science student with a background in Cell and Molecular Biology.
home.description2: I'm a Master's student in Informatics at NTNU, specializing in interaction design, game and learning technology, who enjoys building simple and user-friendly solutions.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I enjoy solving problems and building web experiences that combine development, architecture, and design. I'm especially interested in how technical solutions can create intuitive and engaging user experiences, and I like exploring creativity through interactive design.
about.p2: With a background in Cell & Molecular Biology, I've gained a cross-disciplinary perspective and a broader understanding of how data modeling approaches can solve complex problems.
about.p3: Outside of tech, I'm social and actively involved in my student association. here I have gained experience with coordinating volunteers, working with administration and communication to create a inclusive environment. It's something I truly value and an experience I would never want to be without. It has taught me a lot about collaboration, responsibility, and being part of something bigger.

education.title: Education
education.desc1: Specialization in Interaction Design, Game and Learning Technology, focused on building interactive systems with the user experience at the centre.
education.details1: In-depth study of designing graphical user interfaces with user-centred methods, the theory behind computer games and how ideas become playable experiences, and how digital tools can support teaching and learning. The degree includes practical projects in interdisciplinary teams and concludes with a master's thesis.
education.desc2: Effective, safe and flexible software development, algorithms, building user-friendly applications.
education.details2: Broad knowledge of programming, system development, software and communication-based systems, with an emphasis on building user-friendly computer systems. Practical experience with database design, web technologies, interaction design and information security, along with an understanding of the role of information technology in society and of sustainable development.
highlights2: Exchange semester at the University of Padua, autumn 2025.
Bachelor's thesis: development of a health application for mapping and detecting cardiometabolic risk factors using the Hjertefrisk algorithm.
education.desc3: Specialization in Cell and Molecular Biology, providing a strong foundation in scientific research and analytical thinking.
education.details3: Knowledge of living organisms, from molecular processes in the cell to the diversity of organisms, with an in-depth focus on the structure and function of cells and on heredity, DNA, RNA and proteins. Hands-on lab experience with methods in molecular genetics, protein separation, protein identification and immunology, and with processing, interpreting and presenting results from lab experiments.
